item.title: Neural Concept: $100 Million Series C Closed To Scale AI-Native Engineering Platform
item.description: Neural Concept has closed a $100 million Series C funding round led by Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, as the company looks to scale its CAD-native, physics-aware AI platform across enterprise engineering workflows. The round included participation from existing investors Forestay Capital, Alven, HTGF, D. E. Shaw Ventures, and Aster Capital. item.title: Picus Capital: €150 Million Preferred Equity Financing From Carlyle AlpInvest Closed
item.description: Picus Capital has closed a €150 million preferred equity financing from Carlyle AlpInvest, a private markets manager, in a deal the Munich-headquartered venture capital firm said will provide flexible capital for new investments and continued support for its portfolio of nearly 200 companies. item.title: Destinus: €50 Million Commerzbank Facility Closed, Lifting Total Capital Raised To Nearly €400M
item.description: Destinus, a European aerospace and defense company headquartered in the Netherlands, has secured a €50 million commercial bank financing facility from Commerzbank, marking the company’s first commercial bank facility and backing its next phase of industrial expansion across Europe. item.description: Dazzle AI, a new startup founded by entrepreneur and former Google and Yahoo executive Marissa Mayer, has raised $8 million in seed funding at a $35 million post-money valuation. item.title: HCLSoftware To Acquire Jaspersoft From Cloud Software Group
item.description: HCLSoftware, the software business division of HCLTech, announced it has signed an agreement to acquire Jaspersoft, an embedded analytics and “pixel-perfect” reporting platform that operates as a business unit of Cloud Software Group. Financial terms were not disclosed. The post HCLSoftware To Acquire Jaspersoft From Cloud Software Group appeared first on Pulse 2.0.

item.title: T-CURX: $20 Million Series A First Closing Raised To Advance Non-Viral CAR-T Pipeline And In Vivo Platform
item.description: T-CURX GmbH said it has completed the first closing of a $20 million (€17.7 million) Series A financing to accelerate the clinical development of its non-viral CAR-T programs in acute myeloid leukemia and solid tumors, while advancing proprietary technologies designed to enable non-viral, in vivo CAR-T generation. item.title: StretchSense: $2.3 Million Raised To Drive Global Expansion Of XR Training Gloves
item.description: Wearables technology firm StretchSense, which develops high-tech hand data capture gloves, has raised $2.3 million (£1.75 million) in a funding round led by PXN Ventures and supported by Scottish Enterprise as it pushes global expansion of its extended reality training glove for enterprise and government use. item.title: NextFoods: $10 Million Series 3 Raised To Expand Science-Backed Functional Wellness Portfolio
item.description: NextFoods, the parent company of functional nutrition brands Cheribundi and GoodBelly, has closed a $10 million Series 3 funding round led by ECP Growth. The company said the financing will support product innovation, brand expansion, and deeper retail partnerships as demand rises for everyday wellness solutions spanning gut health, muscle recovery, and sleep. item.title: Imprint: $150 Million Series D At $1.2 Billion Valuation Raised To Expand Co-Brand Cards Into A Full Loyalty Platform
